topic: clean a camera lens without scratching it
core_question: How do I clean my camera lens without scratching the glass?
answer_summary: Remove loose particles with a rocket blower or soft brush first, then wipe in gentle circular motions with a microfiber lens cloth or lens tissue, using a drop of lens cleaning solution for smudges — never a shirt or paper towel.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; writing in full careful sentences
